purpose: Test whether the cost of extra inputs comes from their number or from fluctuation unrelated to the other inputs: copies of kept electrodes, mixes of copies and noise, and one noise waveform repeated, added to the 16 most relevant electrodes.
claim_boundary: Exploratory for BCI IV 2a, planned after its test results and the input-cost and noise-mechanism results were known. For Lee2019 the predictions are fixed before any of these models is scored on Lee2019 session 2; three predictions, no correction for multiplicity. It explains a result; it does not change the frozen 2a configuration.

K1.claim: Copies cost less than independent noise
K1.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: dup-46 minus relevance-16-plus-46
K1.also: dup-46 minus relevance-16 is reported; with its interval lower bound above -2 points, copies are described as having no visible cost

K2.claim: Half noise lies between copies and noise
K2.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: dup-46 minus mix50-46, and mix50-46 minus relevance-16-plus-46

K3.claim: One shared noise waveform costs less than independent noise inputs
K3.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: shared-46 minus relevance-16-plus-46

references.noise: relevance-16-plus-k of scripts/input_cost_study.py (a = 1: the same noise inputs)

kinds.dup: exact copies of kept electrodes, the kept electrodes in relevance order (most relevant first), cycled
kinds.mixA: sqrt(1 - a) * the copied electrode standardized with the training partition's mean and standard deviation + sqrt(a) * the input-cost study's noise input at the same position, a = A / 100
kinds.shared: every extra input is the first noise input of the input-cost draw

noise: mibci.noise_mechanism.appended_noise draw 0, the input-cost study's (largest k drawn, cut to k)
predictability: session 1 only: per fold, a least-squares fit (with intercept) from the 16 kept electrodes to each dropped electrode on the training runs; 1 - R^2 on the held-out runs (mibci.input_kind)
analysis: seeds (and folds) averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free session-2 trials, Lee2019 on all; 2a also with the seed error
